_comment: Style Dictionary token SOURCE (A5 / cat 21 — token-pipeline seed). Mirrors the PRIMITIVE :root values in app/tokens.css + brand.config.ts. This is the machine-readable single source that `npm run tokens:build` compiles into tokens/build/tokens.generated.css (a PARALLEL artifact — app/tokens.css stays the hand-authored source of truth the app imports). The point is to prove a tokens.json -> platform-output pipeline exists and stays in step with the shipped ruler; if a fork later adopts more platforms (iOS/Android/JS), they hang off THIS file. Keep values in lockstep with app/tokens.css (the design-tokens contract test guards the AntD<->CSS overlap; this JSON tracks the CSS side).
